messages:
maya: Heads-up — eu-west GPU pools sitting at ~92% and egress from the model shards is spiking. We're now seeing spillover into the warmpool and some requests are queuing >200ms. Thinking we need a short-lived admission policy to protect control plane and VIP SLA.

jason: Got it. Do we want cross-region spill to us-east or soft-model fallback first? Spill adds latency/cost but keeps quality. Fallback to smaller quantized variants saves cost/latency but may affect top-k.

priya: Numbers from the last hour: median latency up 18%, p95 up 42%. Cost impact if we spill all traffic to us-east ~ +26% on token egress for eu customers (est). Fallback to q4_128 model reduces GPU time ~30% and only degrades perf on few prompt families.

tim: Immediate mitigation: can we gate heavy customers with temporary "grace tokens" so committed customers finish in-flight? Then apply admission-control for all others. We should also reduce client-side max_tokens for the hotspot models (2048 -> 1024) via routing-tier override.

maya: Proposal: implement a short-lived header-based admission token flow. Routes:
- X-Redwood-Admission: grace (for canary/paid) -> route to primary eu-west if capacity
- X-Redwood-Admission: standard -> admission controlled into warmpool or queued
- if warmpool full -> spill to us-east with region-tag and degrade-model if flagged

jason: Implementation sketch (envoy filter pseudo-config):
```
- name: admission_control
  typed_config:
    '@type': type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.ratelimit.v3.RateLimit
    domain: redwood_admit
    descriptors:
      - key: admission_type
        value_from_header: X-Redwood-Admission
    rate_limit:
      stage: 0
      token_bucket:
        max_tokens: 50
        refill_rate: 5/s
```

priya: We'll need routing svc changes to interpret the header and apply model-fallback policy. Also add telemetry tag so Optimize/Console shows which customers were folded.

maya: I'll open the PR with the header parsing and admission hook. Need someone to own the fallback model mapping (priya?).

priya: I can own the fallback mapping. I'll generate a short list of models that are safe to degrade and the perf delta per prompt class.

tim: Ops checklist:
- Add runbook step to flip grace-token on/off per customer
- Temp throttle at edge LB for non-grace tokens to 10r/s
- Alert if queue length > 500 for > 5m

deploy-bot: routing-svc staging build 0.41.3 deployed to staging :rocket: (sha: d4c3b2a)

maya: Nice. Plan: roll to production in small batch. Start time ~ 1719001500 (in ~6m). We'll monitor p95, queue len, and per-customer error rates.

jason: Also create cost-estimate for 1h, 3h, 24h of spill so PMs know tradeoffs.

maya: Agreed. I'll handle the PR + runbook. tim, can you adjust LB throttle?

tim: On it — will push the throttle at 1719001300 and confirm when active.

maya: Thanks. If anything spikes after the rollout we revert routing change and keep grace tokens only.

jason: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after 30m check-in. :white_check_mark:
